manifest.title: Smartwatch underside (photo, marks masked)
manifest.depicts: The real back of a smartwatch on a dark background: a round sensor window with four lenses, the case and the crown.

licence.author: Fletcher
licence.attribution: Photo: Fletcher, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (modified)
licence.changes: engraved ring text and logo removed (case texture filled in), darkened, desaturated, light backdrop keyed to dark grey, scaled to 1620 px

brandMarks.notes: Mask baked at source resolution before any crop/scale (D1 #2a); the product shape (case + crown) stays, which D1 #2d allows for this masked photo only.

people.note: object photo on a plain backdrop; no person, face or reflection

brandMarks.note: viewed plate.jpg full frame and a 2x crop of the ring: no logo, no letters left; see research/v3/W3a/brandcheck-watch-back-photo.jpg

sensorWindow.label: the sensor window
sensorWindow.physical: round glass window over the optical heart sensor

lensCluster.label: the lights and sensors
lensCluster.physical: the four lenses together: green LEDs and light sensors sit under them

lens.top.label: a lens
lens.top.physical: one of four lenses (an LED or a light sensor under it; which is not identified)

lens.left.label: a lens
lens.left.physical: one of four lenses (an LED or a light sensor under it; which is not identified)

lens.right.label: a lens
lens.right.physical: one of four lenses (an LED or a light sensor under it; which is not identified)

lens.bottom.label: a lens
lens.bottom.physical: one of four lenses (an LED or a light sensor under it; which is not identified)

crown.label: the crown
crown.physical: the side dial of the watch

treatment.extra: annulus brand mask baked first; backdrop key: bright pixels connected to the image border (flood fill), outside r 0.30 w

caveats: LEDs are UNLIT in the photo: any green light is a drawn, labelled annotation (Glow), allowed by D1 #2e
which lens is an LED and which a light sensor is not identified: never label one specific lens 'LED'
a real product (case shape) with its brand engraving removed: do not name the brand
